levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Symbols are named incorrectly or garments are grouped without checking the label of each one.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Temperature, dryer, bleach, and iron symbols are correctly read on at least three garments and used to group the load.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner correctly identifies and separates out a garment whose instructions do not match the rest of its group.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Wash or dry settings do not match any label in the load, or the machine's fill line is not checked.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Wash and dry settings match the most restrictive label in the load, and the load stays within the machine's fill line.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner explains specifically which garment's label determined the settings chosen.

lookFors: The three garments and their labels are real and specifically described, not a generic description of 'checking labels.'
The load was not overloaded, and the settings named match a label actually present on a garment in the load.

A learner who completed the simulation/equal-credit alternative instead of the real-world version should be scored on this same rubric using the alternative submission as the evidence — using the sanctioned alternative is not itself a reason to score lower.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
